evidence.title: Why your local LLM feels dumber than it is

summary: Recent analysis shows that on‑device language models often seem less capable because they run with lower precision, smaller context windows, and limited compute, not because the underlying model architecture is weaker. Optimizations such as higher‑bit quantization and hardware acceleration can narrow the gap with cloud‑based services.
title: Local LLMs Appear Slower Due to Quantization and Resource Limits, Not Inferior Models
